privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Nova Adi Saputra ("I", "we") collects, uses, and protects the information you provide when visiting this portfolio at frostdev.my.id.

sections.title: Information We Collect
items: Anonymous analytics data via Google Analytics (Google Tag Manager ID: G-VN0QKEYW7Y) — such as pages visited, visit duration, and device information.
Information you submit through the contact form: your name, type of service requested, and message. This data is stored in the system and forwarded to my WhatsApp.
Cookies from third-party services (Google Analytics, Iubenda Cookie Consent) for analytics and legal compliance purposes.

sections.title: How We Use Information
items: Understanding how visitors interact with the portfolio to improve content quality.
Responding to inquiries or collaboration requests you submit.
Ensuring compliance with applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, Indonesian PDP Law).

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
sections.body: This website uses technical and analytics cookies. You can manage your cookie preferences via the consent banner that appears on your first visit. Analytics cookies are used anonymously and do not personally identify you.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
items: Google Analytics — anonymous visit analytics. Google's policy: policies.google.com/privacy
Iubenda — cookie consent management in compliance with GDPR.
WhatsApp — contact form message delivery per Meta's policies.
Google Fonts & Cloudflare CDN — for typography assets and site performance.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body: I apply reasonable security measures to protect your information. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure.

sections.title: Your Rights
items: Access, update, or request deletion of your personal information.
Opt out of analytics data processing by disabling analytics cookies.
Submit questions or complaints regarding privacy via the email below.
